pressure_note: No pressure column is printed. Text: 25-75 C in Lipkin pycnometers; 75-175 C in sealed glass dilatometer tubes 'under the combined pressure of the air trapped in the dilatometer and the water that evaporated from the solution' (air partial pressure about 3 atm at 175 C); i.e. the solution's own saturation pressure plus trapped air, not controlled.
title_as_printed: Densities of Solutions Containing Na2SO4 and MgSO4

value3.what: density calculated by the authors from eq 8 (Young-Smith) with fitted interaction constant k

composition.other_species: pure water as solvent; ternary salt pair per block, set from the label row (Na2SO4 + MgSO4)

extra_unmapped: Calcd. density (authors' correlation) mapped as value3
conversion_needs: density in g/cc (printed as 'Grams per cc.'), no conversion needed

composition molality: mol of salt per 1000 g water as printed ('molality'); the paper defines apparent molal volume with 'V is the volume of a solution containing 1000 grams of water and m moles of solute'
notes: Printed 3x3 column layout (first salt molality in the upper header, second salt in the lower header) restacked to one label row per (m1,m2) pair (9 blocks) followed by 8 temperature rows. Blocks ordered by first-salt molality, then second-salt molality. Calcd is the authors' ternary-correlation density.
